column1: # Pattern B (Target-xbp-Motif-ybp-Target) run on the PPP1R12C intron-3
# interval (AAVS1). Run AAVS1-intron3 / TTR-TTAA-TTR: TnpB preset with the IUPAC
# motif TTR on both outer anchors, the middle motif TTAA matched without any
# mismatch on the plus strand, and an independent [10, 30] bp distance interval
# Interval length: 8898 bp (PPP1R12C-intron3.fa). 17 TTAA sites were located
# and 16 of them carry at least one returned guide; 49 guides were returned in
# total and every one of them is transcribed here. Left guides sit on the left
# of their middle motif, right guides on the right, so one site can carry
# Columns: rank / guide_id / side / y_start / y_end (0-based half-open position
# of the middle motif) / y_seq (the middle motif) / distance (gap in bp
# between the guide's PAM/TAM motif and the middle motif, as written by the
# run) / query (the 23 nt guide the run returned).
# That directory is case-study working data and is not part of the release
# tree, so the numbers are recorded here.
